findings.issue: Cross-task contradiction on the "is this group renamed?" predicate. Task 06 hint says: "If src/ui/groupTitle.ts already exports a predicate for this, prefer that helper over a hand-rolled check — but do not extend groupTitle.ts". Task 05 makes that branch impossible: its AC states "Существует src/ui/groupTitle.ts с ОДНОЙ экспортируемой функцией" and its hints explicitly forbid a second export ("Не добавлять второй экспорт «на будущее» ... YAGNI, ревьюеры это отметят"). So Task 06 will necessarily hand-roll a second trim-emptiness check in EmptyState.svelte — a second, unit-untestable copy of exactly the rule tech-spec Decision 4 centralized to avoid copies.
findings.fix: Resolve ownership before wave 1 runs: either (a) let Task 05 export a second pure predicate (e.g. hasCustomTitle(storedTitle): boolean) with its own unit tests and update Task 05's AC/hints accordingly, and have Task 06 call it; or (b) delete the dead "if groupTitle.ts already exports a predicate" sentence from Task 06 and state plainly that EmptyState performs its own `title.trim() !== ''` check, accepting the duplication.

findings.issue: AC "A whitespace-only stored title behaves exactly as an empty one — default name AND original semantic hint" has no reachable verification. Task 06 adds no automated test by design; tests/e2e/core.spec.ts does not touch titles; and Task 03 normalizes titles both on save and on load (tech-spec Decision 7 — whitespace-only becomes ''), so no UI path can produce a whitespace-only stored title for the Task 10 E2E suite either. The AC is therefore verified only by "manual read-through", while the task itself calls this the "real risk here, because the two decisions are made in different components".
findings.fix: Either move the whitespace rule for the hint behind the Task 05 helper/predicate so it is unit-covered (see previous finding), or restate this AC in Task 06 as a defensive-implementation requirement (both name and hint derived from one and the same expression) rather than an observable behavior, so no reviewer expects test evidence for it.

findings.issue: Runtime precondition is currently unmet: `node -v` in this working copy reports v18.19.1. vitest 4.0.18 pulls vite 7.3.1, whose engines are ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0, so `npx vitest run tests/unit/groupOrderUtils.test.ts` — the only verify gate of this task — cannot run today. This is anticipated (depends_on: ["01"], tech-spec Decision 8, Task 01 step 1 stops and reports a blocker), but it means the whole of wave 1 stalls until the runtime is upgraded outside the repo.
findings.fix: No change to the task file needed. Flag to the orchestrator that Node must be raised to >= 22.12 before wave 1 is dispatched, otherwise Task 01 will legitimately halt and Tasks 03/04/05 have no verification path.

findings.issue: The Files section understates the CSS edit surface. It names only `.tm-group-header__title` (lines 135-139) and `.tm-collapsible-group__title` (lines 219-221) — both line ranges verified correct, both indeed font-only. But the AC requires the counter and the settings/add buttons to stay visible on the row, and none of `.tm-group-header__counter` (140-143), `.tm-group-header__settings` (151-163), `.tm-group-header__add` (168-180), `.tm-collapsible-group__count` (222-225) or the collapsible settings/add rules currently set `flex-shrink: 0`; as flex items with `display:flex` they will be squeezed before the title is. The Implementation hints do mention `flex-shrink: 0` on them, so the requirement is not lost, but the file list implies two blocks when the change touches six or more.
findings.fix: In the Files section for src/styles.css, add that the counter and the two icon-button rules in both header variants also need `flex-shrink: 0`, so the executor and the reviewer expect edits beyond lines 135-139 / 219-221.
